title: PR #1139: DNS error handling - configurable behavior

comments.author: claude
comments.content: Design doc drafted: .design/dns-error-failure-limit.md — 0 open questions, ready for kickoff.

comments.author: claude-dns-fix
comments.content: Plan: Implement is_dns_error predicate in browser_manager.py. Prior commit dc14497 incorrectly skips both failure_count AND restart_required. The spec requires only failure_count be skipped (REQ-3: restart_required must still be set True). Will also add scale test (AC-4: 100+ non-existent domains) and unit test (AC-5: non-DNS neterrors still count).

comments.author: dns-error-impl
comments.content: Plan: The fix/dns-crash-handling branch (commit dc14497) has the right idea but over-exempts DNS errors — it gates the ENTIRE 'if command_status \!= ok' block, which also skips restart_required=True. Per the design spec (REQ-3/AC-3), DNS errors must still trigger browser restart, only the failure_count increment should be skipped. I will: (1) cherry-pick dc14497 onto this branch, (2) adjust the guard so is_dns_error only wraps failure_count increment, not restart_required, (3) add scale test (AC-4) navigating 100+ invalid domains with low failure_limit, (4) add unit test for is_dns_error predicate (AC-5).

comments.author: dns-error-impl
comments.content: Decision: Implementing the change directly rather than merging fix/dns-crash-handling because (1) git merge is blocked by project policy, and (2) the existing branch over-exempts DNS errors — it also skips restart_required=True, violating REQ-3. Will implement the correct version: is_dns_error guards ONLY the failure_count increment.

comments.author: claude
comments.content:
**Hater review of fix commit 1c764e7 — Verdict: Begrudgingly Adequate**

Core fix is correct: three lines gate failure_count increment on dnsNotFound check, logic is sound, integration test covers actual end-to-end behavior with 110 domains.

**MAJOR**: test_is_dns_error_predicate tests a local copy of the predicate, not the actual code in browser_manager.py. If the real predicate changes, this test still passes. Mirrors lie.

**MINOR**: Unused import of CommandExecutionError in test file (F401).

**MINOR**: Same 33 lines of .gitignore Crosslink tooling as issue #2 — second consecutive commit smuggling this in.

**MINOR**: Only dnsNotFound excluded — other DNS neterrors (netTimeout from DoH failures) still count. Defensible but undocumented design decision. Needs a comment: '# Only NXDOMAIN; DNS timeouts/SERVFAIL intentionally still count'

**MINOR**: DNS errors still trigger browser restart (restart_required=True) — commit message says 'DNS failures are not browser crashes' but we still restart after each one. Acknowledged in code comment but contradicts stated rationale.

**NITPICK**: error_text is not None check is redundant — error_text is always a string in the neterror path.
